states.CONNECTED_VERIFIED: integrated in this mission: retrieved on a runner, validated (schema guard, complete read), stored, and read by a named PROPX read model
states.EXISTING_VERIFIED: already read by PROPX before this mission; its sync and read model exist (latest check from the Trust Center)
states.ACCESSIBLE_NOT_YET_INTEGRATED: answered on the runner with usable, licensed data; not yet read by PROPX
states.REDUNDANT_PROVEN: answered, but what it holds PROPX already reads from the primary source (the evidence names it)
states.BLOCKED_AUTH: needs a key, an account or identification PROPX does not hold
states.BLOCKED_TECHNICAL: refused or unreachable from the runner (403 / bot screen / CAPTCHA / connection failure / server error) — never bypassed
states.LICENSE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: answered with usable data, but the licence is not stated or restricts reuse — needs the founder's licence decision
states.PAID_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: a paid or contracted product — needs the founder's approval before any call
states.UNSUITABLE_DATA: answered (or the catalogue was searched), but the content is not material, is stale, is unjoinable or does not exist
states.NOT_ACTUALLY_AN_API: a web page, a PDF / spreadsheet release, a viewer or a missing host — no machine interface to read
states.PENDING_VERIFICATION: listed and plausible, but its rows / schema / licence were not read in this pass — named with what would verify it

notFoundInCatalogue.landUseNational: No national land-use (ייעודי קרקע) layer; only Beer Sheva's compilation (br7-zoning). National plans are links only (tma / tmm / xplan).
